name: savitzky_golay_smoothing
decomposition_rationale: Savitzky-Golay filtering requires computing polynomial coefficients for a given window and degree, followed by a sliding window convolution with specific edge-handling filters. Separating coefficient computation from filtering facilitates reuse for derivative estimation.
